english.title: Use a vehicle displaying a trade licence for a purpose not permitted by that licence
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the holder of

(A)_[a trade licence,]_
(B)_[trade licences,]_

used a vehicle (for which a vehicle licence was not for the time being in force), namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), on a public road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), for a purpose other than prescribed by regulation 37 or 38 of and Schedule 6 to the Road Vehicles (Registration and Licensing) Regulations 2002, namely **(..SPECIFY PURPOSE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 34(1)(b) and (2) of the Vehicle Excise and Registration Act 1994.

other.penalty:
An excise penalty being the greater of either:

A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale.
or
Five times the amount of duty chargeable in respect of the vehicle concerned.

Fixed Penalty Ticket: Fifty Pounds fine

Time limit for prosecutions:
36 months
